fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM70,315. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0004695/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass SPM or equivalent with at least a Credit in three (3) subjects or equivalent; OR Obtain one (1) Credit at SPM level plus a Level-3 Skills Certificate; OR Obtain a recognized MQF Level-3 certificate in a related field; OR Pass UEC with a B in three (3) subjects; OR Pass O-Level with a C in three (3) subjects; OR Pass Malaysia Skills Certificate (SKM) / Community College Certificate (both MQF Level 3) in a related field and pass SPM with one (1); OR Pass STPM or equivalent with at least a C (2.00 CGPA) in one (1) subject or pass STAM with Maqbul; OR Obtain other equivalent qualifications recognized by the Government of Malaysia.
